glosses: a type of music from the island of Puerto Rico featuring a characteristic rhythm played upon frame drums called panderetas
A song, especially one that is catchy and/or personally preferred by the listener; a jam, a tune.

examples.text: Tengo plena confianza en mi médico.
examples.en: I have complete faith in my doctor.

examples.text: Tom parece estar en plena forma.
examples.en: Tom seems to be as fit as a fiddle.

examples.text: Tengo una fe plena en mi médico.

examples.text: Yo tengo plena confianza en sus capacidades.
examples.en: I have every confidence in his ability.
